Name: DE-Assignments
Description: Extracts the teams of users associated with each document.
Statement:
select  ass.DocumentOid as DocumentId,
        right(ass.DocumentTypeName, charindex('.', reverse(ass.DocumentTypeName)) - 1) as DocumentType,
        ass.BusinessObjectTypeName as DocumentSubType,
        ast.Oid as TeamId,
        ast.Name as Team,
        usr.Id as UserId,
        usr.Name as [User],
        ass.ModifiedOnUtc,
        mod.Id as ModifiedById,
        mod.Name as ModifiedBy
from    Assignment ass
            join AssignmentType ast on ast.Oid = ass.AssignmentType
            join UserLookup usr on usr.Id = ass.[User]
            join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = ass.ModifiedBy
